:alt: Both approaches keep the original immutable data file available to old snapshots. Copy-on-write creates a replacement without the deleted row. Merge-on-read retains the data file and adds a position delete file; readers combine them. Compaction later creates replacement files with deletes applied.

Copy-on-write pays during the change. Merge-on-read defers work to readers until compaction applies the deletes.
